propositions: Container restart during in-flight code review causes shutdown drain to timeout at 45s before review completes (260-911s observed), triggering fail-closed -1 vote that blocks automatic reconciler recovery.
Transient GitHub git-fetch hangs exceeding 300s _GIT_TIMEOUT are converted to vote-bearing BLOCK decisions, making changes invisible to backfill reconciler which treats voted changes as finished.
Shutdown drain timeout (DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=45) is undersized relative to review timeout (DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1200), causing teardown-corrupted reviews to emit -1 votes.

Retryable coverage gaps (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should defer voting and leave changes vote-less so the backfill reconciler can retry them within RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.

Terminal coverage gaps (indeterminate, finding) and complete reviews should continue to cast fail-closed -1 votes, with escalation to -1 after N consecutive retryable failures on the same (change_id, revision).
